Ravi: Quick holiday poll idea 00
Ravi: Who's up for an Ugly Sweater + Virtual Background contest next Friday? IRL pics or virtual backgrounds both welcome. Small prize (coffee shop gift card) and bragging rights. :sweater:
Nora: yes!! i'll finally wear my disco reindeer sweater. :deer:
DevBot: Event created: "Ugly Sweater & Virtual Background" 12/17 4pm PT. RSVP updated.
Sofia: can remote folks submit animated backgrounds? mine has falling snow and a tiny anim elf.
Ravi: animated ok as long as it's not audio. keep it workplace-friendly.
Ethan: vote categories? ugly, most festive, best pun, funniest background?
Ravi: let's do two winners: "People's Pick" (anonymous poll) and "Ops Pick" for runner-up. We'll have three silly categories if submissions > 10.
PeopleOps: Sounds fun  we can spare $60 for gift cards and a digital badge for winners. Please keep content PG and inclusive.
Nora: timeline? I might need sewing time.
Ravi: submit a photo or background file by Friday noon. We'll run poll after the meeting and announce winners by 5pm.
DevBot: Reminder scheduled: 1767397523 -> 1767400723 (24h left).
Sofia: also can we combine this with a tiny donation drive? like bring one canned good or donate $5 per entry to local shelter.
PeopleOps: Love that. We'll match up to $100 if team donates (cans at reception or Venmo to company-charity acct).
Ethan: i'll bring canned soup. also thinking of making a gif of my cat wearing the sweater.
Ravi: please no cats near the printer, Ethan. :laughing:
Nora: haha noted. i'll enter. uploading my disco reindeer later.
Sofia: uploaded bg_preview.gif -> caption: 'Santa's WiFi is weak.' :satellite: :snowflake:
DevBot: Submission recorded: Sofia (bg_preview.gif). Total submissions: 1.
Ravi: Perfect. Thanks everyone 389 We'll do a friendly slack poll next Friday and share a collage in #random. Happy holidays early!
